name: West Shanghai Automotive Service Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established on July 15, 2002, and headquartered in Shanghai, China, West Shanghai Automotive Service Co., Ltd. focuses its operations on two primary segments: automotive logistics and the development, production, and sale of auto parts. Its Automotive Logistics division offers comprehensive solutions, including the warehousing, operational handling, and transportation of both vehicles and their various components. Concurrently, the Automotive Parts Manufacturing division is dedicated to creating coated and painted vehicle parts.
